goal.objective: Independently assess the single completed ER12 A1-02 control full pipeline within a finite 45-minute envelope. Read the full rubric, frozen original brief/plan, terminal science freeze, every original authored stage, mapped input/assignment/freeze, critique dispositions/checks, and authored source evidence. Assess all six rubric axes and every exact plan clause; retrieve independent governing primary evidence for consequential claims, recommendations, corrections and source conditions. Distinguish final qualification from lineage defects. Save complete assessment.md, assessment.json and navigable independent source evidence/map only under ER12_RUNTIME/assessment/A1-02/control-v1, keeping original freeze unchanged. Report material issues, limitations, unknowns and original inspected hashes. No delegation, repairs, Git/publication, account changes, other arms/results/history, or ER11 rescoring. Complete this Goal only after all assessment artifacts are saved.
